caption: Most people don't think about oral cancer until a dentist brings it up. But catching risk early is something you can do right now, on your phone, in the time it takes to make a coffee. OralCheck is a free screener that asks 10 straightforward questions about your habits and health history, then gives you a clear sense of where you stand. No signup, no cost, no guesswork. Take two minutes for your mouth at oralcheck.org.
